title: Massachusetts adoption of the federal record and inventory requirements
rule_summary: Persons registered to manufacture, distribute, dispense, or possess controlled substances shall keep records and maintain inventories in conformance with the record-keeping and inventory requirements of the federal Comprehensive Drug Prevention and Control Act of 1970 or any amendment thereof, and the Federal Food, Drug and Cosmetic Act, and with any additional rules or regulations promulgated by the Board of Registration in Pharmacy in the case of a retail drug business or wholesale druggist, or by the Commissioner in all other cases.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate sees that the federal record and inventory requirements are also Massachusetts duties, and that the Board may add rules of its own for a retail drug business.
common_confusions: A duty stated in a federal regulation can still be enforced as a Massachusetts obligation through this section.
verification_notes: Read in the current text of M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 15 on malegislature.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed. A fresh independent audit is still required before any section relying on it is published.
